item.title: Weekend After Exams Week
item.description: Just finished writing my end of semester exams for year 3 semester 2, this marked the end of my 3rd year and marking the beginning of my final year next time we open. I am looking forward to the final school year, and all the opportunities and learning it will bring with it. My my internship at Probase still going, I official ran and entire semester of school on DL(Distance learning) and I’d say it wast that rough, tho yes the final exams where kinda tough but that’s how all final exams are.
